title.from: Document the public curation pages and section fronts on p.apyr.us
title.to: Document the home page feature (section fronts, Reference grids, threads) on p.apyr.us

description.from:
Closing task of the `wire` epic (every Papyrus feature epic ends with a p.apyr.us docs task). Do this after Ryan has chosen the feature name (open question 1) and the rename chore has landed; the docs use the final name.

## Pages (p.apyr.us repo, `AnthusAI/p.apyr.us`, content under the "Newsroom How-To" section unless the site's AGENTS.md says otherwise; merges freely per Ryan 2026-10-25)
1. "Show your newsroom's curation on the public site": what visitors see (accepted References, recommended ones, threads mixed with Stories), the Anth.us example (https://anth.us/newsroom/), the privacy rules (no person identity; which fields are public), the agent-readable twin and llms.txt.
2. "Configure <name> in projection.json": the full settings reference (`wire` block, `pages[].source` layout with `::include{kind="references"}` / `kind="threads"` attributes and the three selections, page-level de-duplication rule, `home.layout: sections`, `urls.sections.<name>.index`), with the Anth.us `newsroom.md` as the worked example; `backend.plugins: ["<name>"]` and what it deploys (stream, trigger, schedule, optional interval and purge); `papyrus <name> snapshot` CLI.
3. "Section index pages and a home of sections": settings and screenshots from p.apyr.us itself (adopt `home.layout: sections` on p.apyr.us in the same PR if Ryan agrees; otherwise from the fixture).
4. A note in the hosting page: on CMS-style edges `/newsroom*`, `/_next/*`, `/api/*` belong to the CMS; pick another segment; Anth.us is the pure-S3 exception.

## Papyrus repo docs
- `docs/wire.md` (renamed) complete: data files and fields, task, trigger, CLI, troubleshooting (snapshot never ran -> empty grids; reconcile and `_data/wire/`).
- `docs/building-a-papyrus-static-site.md`: cross-link.
- `README.md` feature list: one line.

## Acceptance
Pages live on p.apyr.us (read.p.apyr.us) with Markdown twins; links checked; wording rules (never "Draft": say "Proposed Story"; "Account", never "Organization"; attribution "AI"). Depends on: all other tasks in the epic and the rename chore.
